name: OrthotectButtonFSM

loading.description: Async execution underway. Action locked against double-submission. Spinner replaces or flanks label without dimming contrast.

successFeedback.description: Brief confirmation state (spring animation checkmark). Auto-transitions back to idle.

errorFeedback.description: Error shake/red indicator. Displays retry cue and re-arms button.

disabled.description: Explicitly inactive. Requires aria-disabled with explanatory tooltip if reason is non-obvious.

invariants: loading state MUST NEVER use opacity dimming like disabled
destructive button action MUST ALWAYS require danger semantic token
target size MUST satisfy minimum 44px on touch or 32px on pointer devices
